svg.title: Competitive positioning map template
svg.desc: Editable template from swapbiswas.com/blog/competitive-positioning-map/. Scores run 0 to 10 on both axes. To move a dot, change the translate(x,y) on its group: x = 150 + 70 * x_score and y = 820 - 60 * y_score. Rename the axis titles, replace the dot labels, and write one dated source URL per dot in the sources panel. Score each axis from separate evidence. With five or more competitors, check the two axes with =CORREL(x_scores, y_scores) in a spreadsheet before you trust the empty corners.

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
